subject: RM_DecayDrake
label: fermatalis
provenance: owner-labelled regression case from run fauna_cauldron_r2_01; owner PICKED DecayDrake column C (r2) on owner_escalations_cauldron_sheet_2026-10-24; pipeline REGEN on F_SIZE_JUMP (CL-035)
description: A heavy, flightless drake with stunted wings folded over a bloated, sour-sweet belly. The fermatalis breathes out a living haze of yeasts and enzymes that sets almost anything organic around it fermenting, and drives the change at a furious pace: within hours the greenery where it has rested slumps into soft, bubbling mounds of mash. It eats the result and is usually drunk on it — four separate livers keep it alive through the habit. Cooks of the delta count it among the most valuable beasts in the Miasma, for whatever it breathes on ferments in a fraction of the usual time. Hard to tame, but a fermatalis that accepts you, especially if you bring a drink, makes a fine hunting companion.
departures: Stunted, vestigial wings folded flat over the back and sides, too small for flight
Grossly bloated, distended belly, far rounder and heavier than any lizard's
A visible haze or cloud of yeast-mist breathed out from the mouth or nostrils
Heavy, squat drake body: a dragon-shaped head and frame, not a lizard's slender profile
Soft, bubbling mounds of fermenting mash on the ground where it rests
